patient_brief.mechanism: ejected from MVC at highway speed

actions_required: Maintain airway patency with cervical spine precautions.
Consider advanced airway if GCS declines.
Consider repeat CXR or CT chest if respiratory status deteriorates.
Initiate large-bore IV access and administer crystalloid bolus.
Perform focused assessment with sonography for trauma (FAST) exam now.
Consider CT abdomen/pelvis now if FAST positive or hemodynamically unstable.
Consider head CT if GCS declines.
Fully expose patient for complete physical exam.
Assess for additional injuries including extremities and spine.

recommended_actions.rationale: Abdominal seatbelt sign and mild abdominal tenderness raise concern for intra-abdominal injury.
Hypotension and tachycardia suggest potential intra-abdominal or pelvic hemorrhage.

red_flags.immediate_action: Initiate resuscitation and consider FAST/CT abdomen/pelvis now.

limitations: CT images provided, but analysis limited to chest findings only.
